content:
English sentences from articles by the contributors of Global Voices (https://globalvoices.org), from OPUS GlobalVoices v2018q4 (https://opus.nlpl.eu/GlobalVoices/corpus/version/GlobalVoices).

Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 licence (CC BY 3.0): https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Global Voices' attribution policy: https://globalvoices.org/about/global-voices-attribution-policy/

No sentence is included. The English dictionary's word frequencies and next words were counted from these sentences and merged into the word list of the Android Open Source Project's English dictionary, and the English next-word model's probabilities (of each word, and of a word after one or two others) were computed from the same counts over that word list; the counts and the model are the change made.

OPUS: J. Tiedemann, 2012, Parallel Data, Tools and Interfaces in OPUS, LREC 2012.
